_provenance: Computed offline by Visa's official Node SDK, cybersource-rest-client 0.0.84 (npm), installed in a temporary directory outside this repository (npm i cybersource-rest-client@0.0.84) and never added to it. Outputs are the SDK's own: Signature = src/authentication/http/HTTPSigToken.js getToken(merchantConfig, logger, date) (which calls SignatureParameterGenerator.getSignatureParameter), Digest = Constants.SIGNATURE_ALGORITHAM ("SHA-256=") + src/authentication/payloadDigest/DigestGenerator.js generateDigest(merchantConfig, logger), exactly as src/ApiClient.js builds its digest header, with a MerchantConfig (authenticationType http_signature) given the inputs below. No network, not a sandbox call: the Visa Acceptance sandbox is not available to this project.
_dummyCredentials: DUMMY credentials, not real and not secret: merchantId and keyId are placeholders, and sharedSecret is the base64 of the 32 ASCII bytes 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef. The bodies hold Sample values only (no card data).
